description: Use this when the user asks how to contact Zola, or needs a person to solve a problem with an order, a payment, or a Zola account. Gives the email, phone number, and hours of Zola customer support, the Zola Help Center link, and the contacts for wedding vendors, product vendors, and the press. Do not use to answer how a Zola product works (use zola_search_help_articles first).
